Twelve comments

Minstrel’s Fancy

This isn’t an uncommon tune, but I’m afraid I don’t know that much about it, only how to play it. Any comments welcome.

↳ Posted by Dr. Dow on April 5th, 2004.

Minstrel’s Fancy

Recorded by Frankie Gavin on his flute album, which I’m surprised to see isn’t in the Recordings listings - but it will be soon. A nice, simple hornpipe, especially on flute or whistle.

↳ Posted by Kenny on April 5th, 2004.

Buck Minstrel

Frankie Gavin has it as “Buck From The Mountain”.

↳ Posted by Kenny on April 6th, 2004.

Hanover Hornpipe

The Buck from the Mountain

It seems this hornpipe was popularised through the recording of Leitrim flute player John McKenna. Here’s the version based on Marcas O’Murchu’s playing:

K: Dmaj

My brother got this tune from Kieran Hanrahan recently and Kieran called it “The Sunshine Hornpipe”. I know there is another hornpipe by the same name but that’s not uncommon so I stuck it under the alternate names.
